summary: Discovery call. Pain: HubSpot workflows break at their scale. Sarah wants consolidation.
Full platform demo. David asked detailed API rate-limit questions. Positive.
Technical eval doc returned. Your API scored ahead of Marketo on 9 of 11 criteria.
Sent proposal v1: $120K ACV platform + implementation.
Security questionnaire (78 questions) assigned to your team via vendor portal. Due in 14 days.
Sarah: 'Loved the proposal. Need exec alignment - can you help me build the business case?'
Michael joined late, asked one question: 'What did your last three implementations actually cost beyond license?' Call ended before you answered fully.
Sarah forwarded internal thread: Jennifer's team OKR this year includes 'consolidate MarTech stack from 14 tools to 8'.
Offered reference call with similar-industry customer. Sarah accepted for 4/22.
Reference call for 4/22 cancelled by our side - SE double-booked. Never rescheduled.
Sarah: 'Michael keeps repeating a horror story from his last company - a MarTech rollout that ran 9 months over. It's not really about the price.'
Task created: 'Answer security questionnaire' - unassigned, still open as of today.
Sarah shared Marketo's offer: 30% off list, 1-year term only, auto-renews at full list price, implementation billed separately.
Sarah: 'Jennifer doesn't do vendor meetings. She reads one-page briefs on Sunday nights. Michael reports cost overruns to her monthly.'
Asked Sarah for another exec meeting slot. No reply for 6 days - unusual for her.
